head: Deevo prayer journal app for iPhone keeps entries on your phone
dek: Deevo is a devotional journal for prayer, Scripture and reflection, with guided templates, prayer lists and an offline King James Bible. The $1.99 iPhone app came out on 23 November and was #95 among paid Lifestyle apps on the US App Store on 25 November.
details: You can start from guided formats such as S.O.A.P. and A.C.T.S. or a blank page, and add verses, photos and voice memos. Prayers can be sorted by category and marked answered, and a yearly reading plan has morning and evening readings. Version 1.1 added Home Screen widgets and Live Activities. The journal stays on the device with no account, and you can make password-protected backups in Files. It's made by developer Renthel Cueto.
means: If you keep a prayer journal on paper and want it on your phone without an account, this is a new option.
todo: Set up a password-protected backup in Files, since entries stay only on your device.
